Our Story

A Love Worth Celebrating

What began as a quiet friendship blossomed into a love neither of them could have imagined. Through laughter, adventures, and quiet evenings, Richard and Bevvy Gay discovered in each other a partner, a confidant, and a lifelong companion. Today, they invite you to witness the beginning of their greatest adventure — a life built together, in faith and in love.

Venue & Directions

✦ Holy Ceremony · 10:00 AM
Iglesia Ni Cristo
Lokal ng Palanan, Makati City
From EDSA Buendia exit, head east then turn right onto Palanan Road. MRT Buendia Station — short tricycle or taxi ride. Street parking available.

✦ Wedding Reception · 12:00 PM
Le Parc
Pasay City, Metro Manila
From Makati, proceed via Roxas Boulevard heading south toward Pasay. Accessible from MRT Taft Ave Station. Valet parking available. Shuttle from ceremony may be arranged.
